legal.draft: Draft pending legal review. This text is a starting point and is not legal advice.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Account details (name, email), the business information you enter (customers, quotes, jobs, invoices, expenses, inventory), and basic technical data needed to run the service, such as session cookies and language and theme preferences.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: Only to provide and secure the service for your company. We do not sell your data and we do not use your customers' information for advertising.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: Each company's data is isolated from other companies. Inside your company, people see only what their role allows. Platform staff can see company-level counts and subscription status, not your customers, money or documents.

sections.title: Receipts and AI
sections.body: If receipt reading is enabled, the receipt image you choose is sent to an AI provider to suggest the amount, date, merchant and category. You review every suggestion before saving.

sections.title: Service providers
sections.body: We use infrastructure providers to host the database, files and application. They process data only to deliver the service.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us to export or delete your company's data. Contact us using the details on our website.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about privacy can be sent to the contact address published on our website.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: BrillaPro is software that helps cleaning companies manage customers, quotes, jobs, invoices, expenses and inventory.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for the activity under your account and for keeping your password safe. Owners decide who in their company can sign in and with which role.

sections.title: Your data
sections.body: Your data remains yours. You grant us permission to store and process it only to provide the service. You are responsible for the accuracy of the documents you create and for complying with the laws that apply to your business, including taxes.

sections.title: Plans and payment
sections.body: Plans limit how many people can sign in. During the free trial you can use every feature. Prices and billing terms will be shown before you subscribe.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not misuse the service, attempt to access other companies' data, or upload unlawful content.

sections.title: Suspension
sections.body: We may suspend access for non-payment, abuse or security reasons. Your data is kept so the matter can be resolved.

sections.title: Availability and liability
sections.body: We work to keep the service available but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to the amount you paid in the previous twelve months.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. We will give notice of material changes.
